description: Office Pulse regression catalog. Every shipping change should re-check these cases via npm run test:bugs.

cases.title: Agent auto-update skipped missing files when versions matched
cases.reproSummary: Install at 1.5.7 with matching server version but missing test-connection.ps1 or logs/setup.log layout. Hourly/soft update previously skipped Install-AgentScripts because versions matched, leaving incomplete installs.
cases.assertion: setup.ps1 must repair when Get-MissingAgentLayoutFiles is non-empty even if local version equals server version; required layout includes test-connection.ps1.

cases.title: Force-update self-kill of setup left .setup.lock loop
cases.reproSummary: Force reinstall stopped PowerShell processes whose command line matched OfficeTracker/setup, including the running setup itself. Kill aborted reinstall and left .setup.lock, blocking retries for ~10 minutes.
cases.assertion: Stop-RunningAgentProcesses must protect current PID ancestry and skip installerMarkers (setup.ps1, update.ps1, run-update.vbs).

cases.title: Stale agent version mapped to force wipe (later stale=soft)
cases.reproSummary: Outdated agentScriptVersion previously triggered forceAgentUpdate. Force wipes the install folder first; any failure stranded the laptop and stopped presence sync.
cases.assertion: getDeviceForceAgentUpdate returns true only for admin Push (forceAgentUpdate flag), never solely because version is stale.

cases.title: Visit closed with invalid times (sleep checkout endAt before startAt)
cases.reproSummary: Sleep/suspend checkout used a suspend timestamp before the open visit startAt, producing endAt < startAt and breaking day hours. Anonymized case shape: UserA office visit then laptop sleep.
cases.assertion: validateVisitTimestamps rejects end before start; agent skips sleep checkout when suspendAt is before open start; server can reopen inverted wifi visits.

cases.title: hours_started never firing because visit existed before alert eval
cases.reproSummary: Events-mode sync writes today's visit before heartbeat alerts run. A prior-presence gate then always saw the visit and never queued hours_started.
cases.assertion: selectHeartbeatAlertTypes queues hours_started from inOffice + AlertDispatch, not from absence of a visit row.

cases.title: Teams/Power Automate ack blocked when webhook missing
cases.reproSummary: Both-channel alerts persisted in-app but never acknowledged when POWER_AUTOMATE_WEBHOOK_URL was unset, so the same alert retried every beat.
cases.assertion: dispatchUserAlerts with webhookUrl null still acknowledges in-app for deliveryChannel both; teams-only stays pending.

cases.title: monthly_snapshot / hours_met once-per-day via AlertDispatch
cases.reproSummary: Positive office alerts could spam Teams/in-app unless deduped by userId+type+dayKey on AlertDispatch.
cases.assertion: wasAlertDispatchedToday / filterUndispatchedAlertTypes drop types already recorded for the dayKey; selectHeartbeatAlertTypes respects hoursMetSent and monthlySnapshotSent.

cases.title: Hobby prod live agent URL is office-tracker-theta.vercel.app
cases.reproSummary: Agents and fallback app URLs must point at Hobby prod theta, not paused Enterprise or wrong project hosts, or install/update and dashboard links break for the pilot.
cases.assertion: Default NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL fallbacks and sanitized apiUrl accept https://office-tracker-theta.vercel.app.

cases.title: Heartbeat in-office uses SSID allowlist
cases.reproSummary: Core presence: OfficeConnect / ExternalConnect / pwcglb.com count; personal hotspots and VPN do not.
cases.assertion: heartbeatInOffice re-evaluates from SSID against allowlist.

cases.title: Daily office hours target defaults to 5 hours
cases.reproSummary: Pilot policy: users need >=5 hours in office per day toward monthly days.
cases.assertion: DEFAULT_HOURS_TARGET is 5; dayQualifiesForTarget uses that threshold shape.

cases.title: Events-mode agent sync processes visit lifecycle
cases.reproSummary: Pilot agents run agentMode=events: queued visit_start/visit_end/activity_tick sync to /api/agent/sync.
cases.assertion: parseAgentSyncEvents accepts visit lifecycle events; catalog indexes full processAgentSync coverage.

cases.title: Live Windows force-reinstall on PwC laptop (process kill + lock)
cases.reproSummary: End-to-end: admin Push update on a real PwC laptop while heartbeat task is running; confirm setup completes and .setup.lock clears.
cases.assertion: Manual: force reinstall finishes, task PwCOfficePulse remains, sync resumes within one interval.
cases.skipReason: Requires Windows agent + live admin Push; covered by BUG-002 static guards and docs/agent-regression-matrix.md C7
